sections.label: Selected projects
sections.title: Things I've built (or am still building)
sections.content:
A few projects from different corners of my interests:

- **AI Lifelog & Memory System** · *Python, SQLite, Linux* — An ongoing personal system that turns conversations into structured journal entries, with long-term memory and layered summaries.
- **File Tamper Detector** · *Java, Swing, SHA-256, JUnit* — A desktop tool that monitors selected files and detects modifications, additions, and deletions.
- **ParkShare** · *Python, FastAPI, Supabase* — A team hackathon project for sharing and reserving parking spaces. I worked on availability and booking-conflict logic.
- **AlphaGen** · *Python, machine learning* — A supervised-learning experiment to predict next moves from Generals.io replay data.

There are a few more experiments too, from Monte Carlo simulations to Windows utilities and small games. Some end up on [GitHub](https://github.com/harkerxia); others stay as notes for a while.

sections.label: About this place
sections.title: Why HarkerX Harbor?
sections.content:
I started blogging in 2023. The site has changed its look (and framework) a few times, but the idea is still pretty simple: somewhere to keep notes, document projects, and write about things I might otherwise forget.

It's mostly a blog, with room for experiments and whatever I feel like making next. No grand mission statement — just a corner of the internet that's mine.
